quarterly_data.quarter: Insyde Software IR presentation: Investor Update June 2026 (06-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Insyde describes itself as an Independent BIOS Vendor (IBV) and claims to be the '#1 BIOS Vendor for Notebooks by Market Share'. Its products are InsydeH2O UEFI BIOS firmware and Supervyse OpenBMC firmware, used for managing baseboard management controllers in servers, storage and networking devices; markets are client computing, server & storage (data center, enterprise server, storage, networking) and embedded & edge. Revenue types: source-code disclosure fees, per-unit royalty fees on customer products shipped with Insyde firmware, and NRE engineering fees. 700+ employees worldwide.

quarterly_data.quarter: Insyde Software IR presentation: Investor Update June 2026 (06-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Insyde Supervyse OPF is ready for ASPEED 8th-generation BMC chips. Company view: 'New AI Racks Provide Many Opportunities For Insyde Firmware' - InsydeH2O and Supervyse OPF act as the single point of management for the entire AI rack's power, thermal and compute system: compute trays across heterogeneous silicon, CDU thermal management, power shelves (PSU/BBU) for peak shaving and load balancing, and scale-out / scale-up switch trays.

quarterly_data.quarter: Insyde Software IR presentation: Investor Update June 2026 (06-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TapRUUT is Insyde's platform root-of-trust product family: verified boot, protection and recovery per NIST SP 800-193, native OpenBMC integration via Supervyse OPF, post-quantum cryptography readiness (MEC 17XX, AST1080) and early alignment with CHIPS Alliance OpenPRoT. Insyde firmware supported major OEM shipments on Intel Core Ultra Series 3 (Panther Lake), Ryzen AI 400 Series (Gorgon Point) and Snapdragon X2 Elite/Plus platforms.
